criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Four frames strong (03 precast blocks, 08 lectern, 09 night sign, 07 room). 06 reads as flat cream boxes against black with streaked ground; 02 a green outline on a noise plane with a hatched channel and nothing measuring 1,340 m; 04 an untextured plank under a fifth of the frame in grey-middle crust; 05 lavender mid-value flats with no sodium lights. 01's sign is small with no long cast. 07 a light leak between chairs.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One deck: dark sky field, light type, one low left key, green means the line; bookend and line motif work. Value strobes on 02, 04, 05, 06 lifted ground planes; 05 lavender; 04 outside the deck's material finish.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. The cover's 'let about 444 acres go' joins c9 and c3, and the caption's 'doesn't reach it' glosses 'circumventing'. Not hard fails.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: County, both bodies, the decision, date, time, address and what a reader can do. No route for someone who can't attend.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 02 and 03 pay, 04 turns. 08 sits after the hearing frame and reads out of order; 07 and 09 both carry the date and address.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Specific and on register. 07's 'Both are up for consideration.' repeats; 'Drawn to illustrate.' reads as boilerplate.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Subjects and palette diverge from nos. 71 to 73; the staged dark chassis and kit heroes are familiar.

one_sentence_fix: Restage 06, 02 and 04 so one subject fills a third to two thirds of the frame in a pool with the ground falling to black beyond it.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: flat cream boxes on a hard horizon against black, ground smeared by the fov 6 lens
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: widen to about fov 18 from about 400 m, rim the stack, warm seam sky behind, kill the streaks

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: a rug on a noise plane, hatched channel, two-line road, nothing measures 1,340 m
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: riprap as rock geometry with a moored ship at true length, a scale object on the road, pool the near corner

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: untextured plank under a fifth of the frame in grey-middle crust
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: camera 0.3 m off the foot so lath and hole fill the lower two thirds, grain, cloth flagging, crust to black beyond 2 m

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: lavender mid-value flats, no sodium lights on the seam
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: pool the nearest five stakes, flats to black past 30 m, warm sodium points on the left seam

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: light leak between chairs, rows cropped so 28 can't be counted
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: raise and pull back so all 28 sit uncropped, clamp the floor spill
